title: Benny Goodman's temper at the Waldorf
summary: Clayton tells stories of Goodman firing musicians nightly, raging in the dressing room, and walking into a closet.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Oh just, just/'72. This must have been about ten years ago.
How do you get along with him personally?
Okay. Yes, but I never know what he's going to do. You never know what, if he

gets mad you don't know what he's mad at. One night he came in the dressing room and we don't know yet why he was mad, he just came in and he was so mad he was red, you know. He worked himself up to something. When he came in he says, I want you guys to listen to me. He says, I'm the boss, I want you to know that. I'm the boss and I want you to play to suit me, don't play to suit yourself

So we didn't know what the heck he was talking about. And he just raved like that for about five minutes. Nobody said a word. He opened the door to go out and walked right into the broom closet. He picked the wrong door and he was, oh boy, we could have killed ourselves with laughing.
Well I have a feeling that he may be a little mellower now.
Yes. I mean from what I've seen he seems to be more tolerant of other people's .....
Yes, I think so. But somewhere, he'd just been somewhere with Mosey Alexander on drums and he got mad at Mosey and played the whole concert without drums. He told him, you sit on
the side. And that's been in the last two months. He played the concert with no drums just because he was mad.

I know when he was playing at Freedom Land once he'd got Cootie in the band and I went down to hear him and in the intermission I said to Cootie, I said, where's the bass player? He said, oh he fired him last night and forgot to get another one. (LAUGHTER).
He's kind of, you know, I think he's very amusing too. You know, he's got a funny kind of wit.
Yes. He never, he says some funny things to me like he said, Hey Buck....................
